title: Bamboo Bicycle Club Launches New Workshop in Toulouse
body_html:
Toulouse, France – May 2024 – The Bamboo Bicycle Club, a pioneer in sustainable bicycle manufacturing and DIY frame building, is thrilled to announce the opening of its new workshop in Toulouse, France. This new location, led by renowned Bamboo Frame Builder Guillaume Denneulin, marks a significant step in the Club’s mission to revolutionize bicycle manufacturing through locally-made production.

Building Locally, Expanding Globally

Founded in London, the Bamboo Bicycle Club has consistently been at the forefront of utilizing bamboo—a sustainable and high-performance material—for bicycle frames. The Toulouse workshop embodies the Club’s commitment to expanding its global presence, empowering individuals to build their own bespoke bamboo bicycles locally.

James Marr, co-founder of the Bamboo Bicycle Club, expressed his excitement about the new venture: "Our dedication to local production and sustainable practices is now firmly established in Toulouse, where we aim to replicate the success of our London and Amersfoort workshops. Under the expert guidance of Guillaume Denneulin, we look forward to offering the finest bamboo bike building experience and fostering a community of knowledge-sharing."

How to Get Involved

Interested in building your own bamboo bike? Sign up for a workshop today at Bamboo Bicycle Club Frame Building Workshop.

Future Prospects

Looking ahead, the Bamboo Bicycle Club plans to further expand its reach through a robust partnership scheme. If you're a makerspace or bike shop interested in offering frame-building workshops and need support to start, please get in touch with us. Our goal is to cultivate a widespread community of bamboo bicycle enthusiasts and skilled builders, contributing to a more sustainable future in cycling.

Contact Us

For more information on how to participate or partner with us, visit our website or contact our support team. We're excited to bring you into the world of bamboo bicycle building, where you can create not just a bike, but a lifestyle.
